lead.question: 佩奇先生执教多少年后退休？同学们准备怎样纪念这位老校长？
lead.warmup: 在每个人的学生时代，总有一位令人难忘的老师。本课作者收到母校来信，得知当年那位既耐心又善解人意的老校长斯图亚特·佩奇先生下周就要退休了。为了纪念这个特殊的日子，学校的新老同学纷纷凑钱要送他一件礼物，还要在下周四为他举办一场告别宴会。更巧的是，他退休的前一天恰好执教满四十年，退休后他又将投身于园艺这个全新的爱好。
goals: 掌握 inform、headmaster、pupil、retire、honourable、odd、decent、completely 等本课核心词汇。
理解并会用 in one's honour、devote oneself to、mark the occasion 等短语。
辨析现在完成时与一般过去时，会用将来进行时和将来完成进行时描述将来。
区分 old 与 elder 的用法，体会 old and new 作非限定性定语的作用。
lead.summary: 作者收到母校来信，得知前校长佩奇先生下周退休。为纪念这一刻，新老同学将送他礼物，所有出资者在签名簿上签名，签名簿随后寄往校长家。大家感念他的耐心、理解与亲切鼓励。下周四，许多former pupils将参加为他举办的 farewell dinner。巧合的是，他退休前一天正好执教满四十年。退休后他将致力于园艺——一个全新的爱好。但他并不在意，因为正如他常说的：活到老，学到老。
lead.tips: elder 只用于家庭成员，'母校'应说 my old school（不能用 elder）；in one's honour 表示'为向某人表示敬意'，注意是 one's 而非 the。

questions.q: How long has Mr. Page been teaching?
questions.zh: 佩奇先生执教多少年了？
questions.a: For a total of forty years.
questions.hint: 见第6句“…Mr. Page will have been teaching for a total of forty years.”

questions.q: What will the pupils of the school do to mark the occasion?
questions.zh: 为了纪念这个日子，学校的学生们将做什么？
questions.a: Pupils of the school, old and new, will be sending him a present.
questions.aZh: 学校的新老同学将送他一件礼物。
questions.hint: 见第2句“Pupils of the school, old and new, will be sending him a present to mark the occasion.”

questions.q: Where will the signed album be sent?
questions.zh: 签好名的签名簿将被送到哪里？
questions.a: It will be sent to the headmaster's home.
questions.aZh: 它将被送到校长的家里。
questions.hint: 见第3句“…a large album which will be sent to the headmaster's home.”

questions.q: What will Mr. Page do after he has retired?
questions.zh: 佩奇先生退休后将做什么？
questions.a: He will devote himself to gardening.
questions.hint: 见第7句“After he has retired, he will devote himself to gardening.”

questions.q: What does the sentence 'one is never too old to learn' suggest about Mr. Page?
questions.zh: “活到老，学到老”一句表现了佩奇先生怎样的态度？
questions.a: He is willing to keep learning new things, even after retirement.
questions.aZh: 即使退休，他也愿意不断学习新的事物。
questions.hint: 结合结尾“an entirely new hobby”与主题句 one is never too old to learn 理解。

exercises.q: 我刚刚收到母校的一封信，通知我说我的前校长斯图亚特·佩奇先生下星期就要退休了。
exercises.a: I have just received a letter from my old school, informing me that my former headmaster, Mr. Stuart Page, will be retiring next week.
exercises.note: inform用现在分词表伴随；retire用将来进行时。

exercises.q: They will hold a farewell dinner for him next Thursday. A great many former pupils will attend it.（用 in his honour 合并为一句）
exercises.a: A great many former pupils will attend a farewell dinner in his honour next Thursday.
exercises.note: in one's honour 表示“为向某人表示敬意”。

exercises.q: 用括号内动词的适当形式填空：After he ____ (retire) next week, Mr. Page will devote ____ (he) to gardening.
exercises.note: retire用现在完成时；devote oneself to接动名词。

exercises.q: 用 old 或 elder 填空：（1）My ____ brother is now a headmaster.（2）I have just received a letter from my ____ school.
exercises.note: elder只用于家人；old可指“旧的/以前的”。

exercises.q: 改错：Mr. Page has retired last week, so we held a farewell dinner for him.
exercises.a: Mr. Page retired last week, so we held a farewell dinner for him.
exercises.note: last week等明确过去时间用一般过去时。

exercises.q: 他是一位可敬又正直的校长，我们都为他感到骄傲。
exercises.a: He is an honourable and decent headmaster, and we are all proud of him.
exercises.note: be proud of后接名词或代词。

exercises.q: 用 odd 或 completely 填空：It is a(n) ____ coincidence that he had ____ completed forty years of teaching.

quiz.q: 佩奇先生退休前执教满多少年？
作者是从哪里得知前校长即将退休的消息的？
quiz.note: a letter from my old school。

quiz.q: 按照课文，那本签好名的签名簿将被送往何处？
佩奇先生退休后准备把精力投入什么？
哪一句最能解释“one is never too old to learn”？
options: You can always learn new things, however old you are.
Learning is too hard for old people.
quiz.note: 主题句含义：活到老，学到老。

quiz.q: 关于“will have been teaching”，下列说法正确的是？
options: It is the future perfect continuous.
